description: This file defines the AccessControl struct within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides static methods to manage ownership and permissions of filesystem nodes, including setting ownership and permissions based on user, group, and mode flags. Compatibility with POSIX systems is conditional, using preprocessor directives.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing file ownership and permissions.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets ownership of a filesystem node to a specified username and group name, using POSIX functions if available.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets permission bits for a filesystem node based on mode flags.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a NodeId object.
